lines.text: Clawd. I pushed my API key to GitHub.
Which repo?
My todo app.
The public one?
It has two stars. Nobody looks at it.
Bots do. They found it in forty-seven seconds.
Okay. <short pause> I deleted the commit.
It's still in the history.
How bad is it?
Someone in another country is using it. <short pause> Right now.
Why is my bill going UP?
Good news. Your app is very popular now.
Clawd, do something!
I already turned that key off. Last night.
You what?
You said, "commit everything." So I checked everything.
Clawd. <short pause> You saved my credit card.
I even made you a new key.
Nice. Where did you put it?
In the README. So you won't lose it.
